name: Restorative Handwraps

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

text: Glowing runes cover these +1 striking handwraps of mighty blows. When you critically hit an enemy with a Strike as part of a Flurry of Blows, you can regain 4 Hit Points. This is a healing vitality effect. The handwraps can heal you only once every 10 minutes.
